compartment.definition: The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.
compartment.name: plasma membrane

compartment.definition: The part of the cytoplasm that does not contain organelles but which does contain other particulate matter, such as protein complexes.
compartment.name: cytosol

compartment.definition: The space external to the outermost structure of a cell. For cells without external protective or external encapsulating structures this refers to space outside of the plasma membrane. This term covers the host cell environment outside an intracellular parasite.
compartment.name: extracellular region

disease.definition: A leishmaniasis that involves skin infection caused by Leishmania species, resulting in one or more cutaneous lesions.
name: cutaneous leishmaniasis

summation.displayName: Activated PLCG translocates to the plasmamembrane and intera...
summation.text: Activated PLCG translocates to the plasmamembrane and interacts with the inositol ring of the membrane bound phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PIP2) with its PH domain. The active enzyme promotes intracelllular signaling by catalysing the hydrolysis of PIP2 to generate the second messengers IP3 and DAG.
